sources.title: bartowski/NousResearch_Arete-27B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: An _L name is simply the large size of its family. Q4_K_L is to Q4_K_M what Q4_K_M is to Q4_K_S; Q6_K_S, Q6_K and Q6_K_L are the small, medium and large sizes of Q6_K, with Q6_K_L about halfway to Q8_0. In earlier releases an _L name meant the embedding and output weights were kept at Q8_0; in these files it means the larger size of the base type.
